summary: Completed comprehensive audit of Engineering department - tested all menu groups, workflows, and API endpoints for both eng_leader and eng_staff roles. Found mostly working system with minor UX improvements needed.

minor_issues.issue: Requires year and month query parameters but returns 422 without them
minor_issues.impact: Frontend needs to pass year/month parameters when calling KPI endpoint
minor_issues.recommendation: Add default parameters (current year/month) or make them optional

design_issues.issue: Missing DialogTitle for accessibility (screen reader users)
design_issues.recommendation: Add DialogTitle wrapped in VisuallyHidden component or add aria-describedby

ux_gaps.issue: Material Costing menu not visible for eng_staff (may be intentional based on role permissions)
ux_gaps.recommendation: Verify if Material Costing should be accessible to eng_staff or if current behavior is correct
